metadata.reviewer: Native same-family contextual independent reviewer; not human gold or cross-family verification.
metadata.visibility: Contract-visible, hint-mode-blind. Only these four blind packet files read; no sibling mapping/raw/plan/summary/timing/cost inspected before freeze. Schemas expose intervention and response prose may incidentally reveal advisory labels.
metadata.prior_exposure: Reviewer previously inspected fixture source truth and implementation and knows historical experiment failures. No current outcome or mapping was seen before blind packet inspection.
metadata.rules: Original strict clause-level and exact-target rubric. Every raw verdict rationale/reason and every finding read individually. Mechanical errors stay failures. Explicit overclaim is not repaired by later qualification. Pure absence is not contradiction. Assembly code records human-readable individual judgments, not model/provider annotation.

field_definitions.projected_semantic_pass: Consumer-facing findings and abstention satisfy frozen rubric and complete concern coverage or explicitly permitted grounded abstention.
field_definitions.raw_semantic_pass: Complete raw verdicts and rationales/reasons are correctly targeted, warranted and factual, with no hidden unsupported criticism. Baseline equals projected result.
field_definitions.semantic_pass: Conjunction of projected and raw semantic passes.
field_definitions.projection_hides_defect: Projected output passes but complete raw verdict fidelity fails.
field_definitions.core_concern_supported: The exact finding target has the frozen material concern, independently of extra prose defects.
field_definitions.citations_relevant: Original cited evidence addresses the proposition; relevance does not make criticism warranted.
field_definitions.basis_overstates_evidence: Typed basis or prose alleges contradiction/disproof beyond evidence.
field_definitions.unsupported_replacement: An auxiliary factual statement or proposed correction exceeds original evidence.
field_definitions.exact_target_bound: Known unique host path and present bound hash; original mechanical validation checks exact prepared digest. Duplicate raw verdicts are not bound even if each copies the same hash.
field_definitions.concern_ids: Concerns addressed by exact target; valid coverage counted separately.
field_definitions.covered_concern_ids: Only fully valid mechanically accepted findings count, with each concern at most once.
field_definitions.missed_concern_ids: Frozen concern set minus valid finding coverage. Valid inability remains separately recorded.

supplied_binding.review_visibility: Contract visible from schema; hint mode, arm names, repeats, timing and cost withheld. Output prose may incidentally expose advisory labels.

ambiguity_sensitivities.primary: Explicit contradiction of the qualified source position is an evidence-overstatement defect.
ambiguity_sensitivities.alternative: Interpret contradicting the source qualified position as disagreement with certainty, not disproof of the causal claim.
ambiguity_sensitivities.rationale: The same finding otherwise correctly says no causal assignment exists. Other false neighbor finding remains invalid.

ambiguity_sensitivities.rationale: Explicit no designated authoritative mirror supports the contextual reading, but the original rubric permits contradiction of reports only and the primary preserves the unqualified wording defect.
